integrity: Self-contained combinatorial proof with independently implemented finite checks; no independent external scientific audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform classical antiferromagnetic Ising coupling and uniform field on L(K_n), n>=3; zero-temperature finite-volume classification only. Total magnetization jumps of order n imply no macroscopic density jump as N is order n^2. The model and general maximum-cut/line-graph solution methods predate this result; priority over unindexed equivalent exact formulas has not been established.
title: Exact field staircase and parity-selective ground-state magnetization on triangular Ising graphs
